author: Bobby Grayson
description:
Major migration to Clap for better performance and error messages. Added shell completion files. Breaking change requiring Rust 1.11+.

Sources:
- 92dc402: 'Switch from Docopt to Clap... This commit also adds Bash, Fish and PowerShell completion files to the release, fixes a bug that prevented ripgrep from working on file paths containing invalid UTF-8 and shows short descriptions in the output of -h but longer descriptions in the output of --help.'
title: Switched from Docopt to Clap
